messages.subject: D-RUG this Thursday!
messages.body_plain:
Hi D-RUGgies

We will be meeting this Thursday (7/3) from 10-noon virtually (zoom link <https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09>). This is a group working session so come with your questions for our expeRts, or just bring your laptop and get in some distraction free R-coding time. Additionally, if there are topics you would like to see someone do a deeper dive on, let us know!

Zoom https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz0 <https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09>

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse <https://d-rug.discourse.group/> site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators

messages.subject: FW: ICYMI: join us for a virtual OSS meetup!
messages.subject_clean: ICYMI: join us for a virtual OSS meetup!
messages.body_plain:
In case you didn’t see it elsewhere, here’s an announcement for the UC open source contributors &

maintainers virtual meetup (i.e. writing code in a language like R or python with an open license, or you’re thinking about an open license).  The meetings from this group on our campus have been really welcoming to new folks, so if you’re a beginner, definitely consider coming.  More details below.

Michele Tobias, PhD

Geospatial Data Scientist

DataLab: Data Science & Informatics

UC Davis Library

370 Shields Library

(530)752-7532

mmto...@ucdavis.edu

ORCID: 0000-0002-2954-8710 <https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2954-8710>

Pronouns: she, her, hers

From: opensource-announce Sympa List (request) <opensource-an...@ucdavis.edu> On Behalf Of Laura Langdon
Sent: Tuesday, July 1, 2025 3:00 PM
To: opensource-announce Sympa List <opensourc...@ucdavis.edu>
Subject: [opensource-announce] ICYMI: join us for a virtual OSS meetup!

Join us on July 10th at noon for the inaugural UC open source contributors &

maintainers virtual meetup, bringing together the vibrant open source

community across all University of California campuses! Whether you’re a

seasoned maintainer with years of experience or just thinking about starting

your open source journey, this collaborative space is designed for learning,

sharing, and connecting with fellow UC community members who are passionate

about open source software. We’ll exchange insights, discuss challenges and

successes, discover new projects, and build meaningful connections with peers

from across the UC system. This is the first of three annual meetups where

we’ll celebrate the incredible open source work happening throughout our

universities and support each other in growing as contributors and

maintainers. All experience levels are welcome—from curious beginners to

project leads—as we believe the best learning happens when diverse

perspectives come together.

Meeting link and all details on our  events page <https://ucospo.net/events/#all-campus-virtual-meetup>!

Cheers,

Laura Langdon (she/her)

Community Manager @  UC OSPO Network <https://ucospo.net/>

Book time with me!  30 mins <http://30%20mins> or  50 mins <https://book.vimcal.com/p/lauralangdon/50-minute-meeting-5ryhp>

Questions? Come have a  virtual coffee <https://ucospo.net/events/#virtual-coffeeoffice-hours-ongoing> with me ☕
